data.one_liner: A widget that enables text selection across multiple text widgets.
data.what_it_does: Enables text selection spanning across multiple text and rich text widgets with platform-adaptive handles and popup menus. Provides a controller to listen to and programmatically modify selections.
use_when: You need text selection to span across multiple separate Text or RichText widgets.
You want platform-adaptive selection menus and handles before using Flutter's SelectableRegion.
avoid_when: Flutter's native SelectableRegion already fits your requirements.
Your application requires extensive legacy framework libraries and you cannot provide material_ui or cupertino_ui themes.
strengths: Customizable appearance, popup menu items, and selection painters.
Includes a controller for programmatic selection and event listening.
weaknesses: Requires explicit material_ui or cupertino_ui packages and localizations configuration.
data.setup_notes: Add selectable to pubspec.yaml and wrap target text widgets inside a Selectable widget.
